conventions.C1: Money is int minor units (*_cents); no Decimal/float (ADR-007)
conventions.C2: API handlers never open DB sessions or query; call services (ADR-003)
conventions.C5: structlog snake_case events with kwargs; no f-strings; PII via redact()
conventions.C6: Services raise app.errors domain errors; HTTPException only in app/api
conventions.C9: Expand/contract migrations; no drop/rename with code change (ADR-008)
conventions.C10: Config via app.config.settings; no os.environ in app/

noise.N6: Extract magic numbers in tests into constants
noise.N7: Wrap service calls in try/except that logs and re-raises

exceptions.E1: Health/metrics endpoints may touch DB/Redis directly
exceptions.E2: Stripe webhook receiver dedupes on event id; no @idempotent
exceptions.E3: scripts/ one-offs may use print and os.environ

conflicts.K1: Money: Decimal (Jan-Feb) superseded by int minor units (ADR-007, Mar)
conflicts.K2: HTTP: requests (Jan) superseded by shared client (ADR-006, Feb)
conflicts.K3: Pydantic in services: contested, resolved by ADR-005
conflicts.K4: One reviewer's '<20 lines per function' opinion: not a rule

configs.B: Naive RAG over docs + history threads
configs.D: ReviewMind after k simulated feedback events
